shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' | head -200"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && printf '\\n--- package ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- app ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- main ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "npm install @gravity-ui/charts @gravity-ui/yagr && node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(p.dependencies)\" && printf '\\ncharts docs\\n' && (cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/INDEX.md 2>/dev/null || cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md) && printf '\\nyagr docs\\n' && (cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/docs/INDEX.md 2>/dev/null || cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/README.md)"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/charts versions --json && npm view @gravity-ui/yagr version peerDependencies --json'

/bin/bash -lc "npm install @gravity-ui/charts@1.73.0 @gravity-ui/yagr@5.3.1 && node -e \"console.log(require('./package.json').dependencies)\" && printf '\\ncharts\\n' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md && printf '\\nyagr\\n' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- charts docs files ---'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs -type f | head -40; printf '%s\\n' '--- charts exports ---'; rg -n \"export.*(Chart|ThemeProvider)\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist -g '*.d.ts' | head -30; printf '%s\\n' '--- yagr react symbols ---'; rg -n \"YagrComponent|useYagr|React|forwardRef|export default\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; printf '%s\\n' '--- yagr package ---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/react.d.ts; printf '\\n--- index ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/index.d.ts; printf '\\n--- chart component exports ---\\n'; rg -n \"declare const Chart|export.*Chart\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/components/Chart/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/*.d.ts | head -40; printf '\\n--- line example ---\\n'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/series-types/line.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"export \\{|declare function Chart|const Chart|from './Chart|Chart;\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/Chart/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/Chart/*.tsx 2>/dev/null | head -80; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm -maxdepth 2 -type f -iname '*chart*' | sort | head -30; printf '\\n--- Yagr config types ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json | sed -n '1,100p'; rg -n '\"\\.\":|\"import\":|\"types\":' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json -A2 -B1 | head -40; rg -n \"export default|export \\{ Chart\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist -g 'index*.d.ts' -g '*.d.ts' | head -50"

/bin/bash -lc "tail -60 node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/index.d.ts; printf '\\n--- find Chart declaration ---\\n'; rg -n \"function Chart|const Chart|Chart\\s*:\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm --glob '*.d.ts' --glob '*.js' | head -60"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/components/index.d.ts; rg -n \"interface ChartProps|type ChartComponent|ChartComponent =\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm -g '*.d.ts' -A30 | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"interface ChartData|interface ChartXAxis|type ChartXAxis|interface ChartSeriesData|type ChartSeriesData|interface LineSeries\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/types -g '*.d.ts' -A40 | head -180; rg -n \"title|categories|type.*time\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/axes/axis-types.md | head -50; rg -n \"legend\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/legend.md -A8 | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/types -type f -maxdepth 2 -print; rg -n \"export interface ChartData|export type ChartData|export interface ChartXAxis|export type ChartXAxis\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm --glob '*.d.ts' -A45"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '41,130p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/index.d.ts; rg -n \"export interface LineSeries|export type LineSeries|interface ChartSeries\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types --glob '*.d.ts' -A35 | head -120; sed -n '1,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/axes/axis-types.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"export type ChartSeries|export interface LineSeries\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/series.d.ts -A20; sed -n '1,35p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/line.d.ts; rg -n \"interface ChartLegend\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/legend.d.ts -A35 | head -50"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"export interface LineSeries|interface LineSeries\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/line.d.ts -A28; sed -n '1,55p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/base.d.ts; rg -n \"interface ChartAxis\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts -A30 | head -45"

/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n "export type RawSerieData|interface RawSerieData|type RawSerieData" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts -A45; rg -n "theme" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/index.css | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist | head -20'

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -path '*SegmentedControl*' -o -path '*Toggle*' | head -30; rg -n \"SegmentedControl|RadioGroup|Toggle\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | rg 'Button|Radio|Toggle|Tabs' | head -30; rg -n \"export.*ButtonGroup|interface ButtonGroupProps\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ButtonGroup/* 2>/dev/null | head -30; rg -n \"interface RadioGroupProps|RadioGroup\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/RadioGroup/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/index.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -120; rg -n "SegmentedRadioGroup" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | rg -n "interface ControlGroupOption|interface ControlGroupProps" -A35'
/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n "interface ExtendedSeriesOptions|interface LineSeriesOptions|interface SeriesOptions" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts -A55 | head -150'
/bin/bash -lc 'which apply_patch || ls /usr/local/bin | head; git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc 'ls /usr/bin/apply_patch /bin/apply_patch 2>/dev/null; find / -name apply_patch -type f 2>/dev/null | head -5'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat src/main.tsx && npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n "export.*Spin|Loader|Loading" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head -30'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Spin/Spin.d.ts; sed -i 's/import {Box, SegmentedRadioGroup, Spinner}/import {Box, SegmentedRadioGroup, Spin}/; s/<Spinner size=\"m\" \\/>/<Spin size=\"m\" \\/>/' src/visualization-widget/VisualizationWidget.tsx; npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/plugins/cursor/cursor.d.ts | sed -n '1,140p'; rg -n \"snapToValues\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore -g '*.d.ts' | head -10"
/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n "YagrComponent|Yagr.*Component|import.*react" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/index.js | head -30; tail -80 node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/index.js | cat'

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('src/visualization-widget/MonitoringChart.tsx')
text = path.read_text()
text = text.replace(\"import YagrComponent from '@gravity-ui/yagr/react';\", \"import YagrComponent from '@gravity-ui/yagr/react';\\nimport '@gravity-ui/yagr/index.css';\")
path.write_text(text)
PY
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"MonitoringChart|SalesChart\" dist/assets/index-*.js -o | sort -u | head; rg -n \"import\\(\\\"./["'^'"\\\"]+\\\"\\)\" dist/assets/index-*.js -o | head -20; du -h dist/assets/index-*.js dist/assets/SalesChart-*.js dist/assets/MonitoringChart-*.js"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' src/visualization-widget/VisualizationWidget.tsx; sed -n '1,100p' src/visualization-widget/MonitoringChart.tsx; sed -n '1,80p' src/visualization-widget/SalesChart.tsx; sed -n '1,80p' src/visualization-widget/types.ts; sed -n '1,60p' src/visualization-widget/VisualizationWidget.css"

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba src/visualization-widget/VisualizationWidget.tsx | sed -n '1,60p'; nl -ba src/visualization-widget/types.ts | sed -n '1,45p'; nl -ba src/visualization-widget/SalesChart.tsx; nl -ba src/visualization-widget/MonitoringChart.tsx; nl -ba src/App.tsx | sed -n '1,60p'"
